description: Unsigned transaction closing all or part of the wallet's leveraged long on a stock: the stock is sold, the debt repaid, and the rest comes back in USDG.

percent.description: How much of the position to close, 1 to 100 (default 100)

symbol.description: A stock on Borro by its ticker, like NVDA or AAPL (markets lists every one)

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

name: close_long
title: Prepare: close a leveraged long
